decisive_findings.cause: Orchestrator::restart consumes an already materialized in-memory EventLog. No durable store, expected-head anchor, child-process loader, or crash-safe journal publication exists.
EffectSink::apply mutates before EffectApplied is appended. A crash between those operations cannot distinguish unapplied from applied-but-unrecorded and may double-apply on retry.
Deleting a complete tail event can leave a structurally valid prefix because replay has no independently persisted expected head.

preserved_acceptance: The exact typed lease/scope/artifact authority kernel remains accepted and is not invalidated by these production-recovery findings.
corrective_scope: Implement a versioned, bounded, candidate/context-bound journal with exclusive expected-head append, crash-safe frame publication, durable head anchoring, read-only inspection, and explicit repair classification.
Persist effect intent before invoking the sink. After ambiguous interruption, prohibit blind retry and require exact applied/not-applied reconciliation evidence before commit or safe reapplication.
Persist root-integration intent before root writes and classify none, full, partial, conflicting, stale, or substituted observed digests after restart.

Exercise child-process interruption/restart, duplicate/reordered/deleted/truncated/corrupt frames, concurrent append, stale bindings, special files and aliases, effect crash points, partial root changes, and zero-write inspect/recovery.
claim_ceiling: Only the accepted internal scope/artifact authority kernel is supported. Durable restart, effect recovery, root integration recovery, public orchestration behavior, workstream closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim orchestration completion, readiness, release, or goal completion.
